title: Speculative Rollback Correction for Quality-Diverse Web Agent Imitation
abstract: arXiv:2606.12485v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training interactive web agents through imitation learning from expert trajectories has emerged as a highly effective approach. However, determining the optimal timing for expert intervention presents a critical challenge in this context. Delayed intervention often leads to the accumulation of early-stage errors, pushing the page state into an irrecoverable regime. Conversely, premature or excessive intervention causes the agent to become overly reliant on expert policies, trapping the model in local optima characterized by a single, rigid trajectory. We propose Speculative Rollback Correction (SRC), a branch-level imitation framework for resettable agent environments. translated_title: 推测性回滚修正用于质量多样的网络代理模仿
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.12485v2 公告类型：替换交叉  摘要：通过从专家轨迹进行模仿学习来训练交互式网络代理已成为一种高效的方法。然而，确定专家干预的最佳时机在此背景下是一个关键挑战。延迟干预通常会导致早期错误的累积，将页面状态推入不可恢复的区域。相反，过早或过度干预会使代理过度依赖专家策略，将模型困在由单一、僵化轨迹表征的局部最优中。我们提出了推测性回滚修正（SRC），一种用于可重置代理环境的分支级模仿框架。SRC不要求在每次访问的状态下请求教师标签，也不仅在完整轨迹完成后进行纠正，而是采用固定时域的分支审查：学生先执行一个短暂的推测性片段，然后由教师审查，教师定位第一个有害动作。
tldr: 提出推测性回滚修正（SRC）框架，通过分支级审查和固定时域推测执行，在模仿学习中平衡专家干预时机，避免错误累积和过度依赖，提升网络代理训练的质量与多样性。
en_tdlr: Propose Speculative Rollback Correction (SRC), a branch-level imitation framework with fixed-horizon speculative execution and teacher review to balance expert intervention timing, preventing error accumulation and over-reliance while enhancing quality and diversity in web agent training.
